title: The Marlowe Rewards Birthday Bonus Amount
content:
The Marlowe Rewards birthday bonus is the birthday points of the tier held on the claim date. A tier whose value is 0 receives no birthday bonus, and nothing is posted.

## Worked cases (hypothetical tier figures)

| Birthday points of the tier held on the claim date | Birthday bonus posted |
|---|---|
| 350 | 350 points |
| 500 | 500 points |
| 0 | nothing is posted |
